status_definitions.source_directly_cross_checked_in_this_au: Legacy source-reviewed bucket combining individual live primary-text checks and editorial mapping. Inspect verification_detail.level; the count is not equivalent to individually live-text-verified questions.
status_definitions.source_identified_not_independently_cros: A reference is recorded, but the complete assertion has not been independently checked line-by-line.
status_definitions.withheld_pending_review: Question excluded from the active library due to unresolved issues.
